Refactor the shutdown logic to be threadsafe

Occasionally CI would hang during the `run_kernel()` test. This is most likely
because Julia will sometimes hang if there are tasks still running upon exit,
and `shutdown_handler()` previously did not bother closing all the eventloop
tasks before calling `exit()`. Now `shutdown_handler()` will begin the shutdown
process and allow `run_kernel()` to close the kernel properly.

Make the heartbeat socket a REP socket

This is the socket type specified by the Jupyter messaging spec.

Improve interrupt handling

- Refactored some recursive functions into loops.
- Moved the `shutting_down` variable into a `Kernel` field instead of a global
  variable, this fixes an interrupt issue caused by the global variable being
  set to true during precompilation.
- Replaced the stdio Timer's with a custom loop for robustness.

Fix race condition in stdio watching code

The stream buffer and lock were previously created by `watch_stream()`, and
accessed concurrently by the stream timers.
